title: guarea tessmannii
intro: Guarea tessmannii, commonly known as African Guarea, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation and pain, as well as being used to treat fever and other health issues due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Guarea tessmannii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
